candidats.caption: Localization of the DSD variant on the myosin phosphatase regulatory subunit encoded by PPP1R12A (Original Figure created based on data from PPP1R12A - Protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 12A - Homo sapiens (Human) | Variants viewer | UniProt (https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O14974/variant-viewer) and Tong et al (2024) (11)) Shown here is the RVKF motif in blue, which is important for interaction with PPP1CB, and the interaction domain with Rho-associated coiled-coil-containing protein kinase 2 (ROCK2) in orange. Mild variants (in blue) are associated with less severe external genitalia phenotypes, such as small genital tubercle.
